payload.question: Did the council spend what it planned on day-to-day services?
payload.label: Day-to-day spending against budget, 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council names £1.286m of interest earned on its day-to-day cash inside a £2.992m underspend in Corporate Financing, the central pot. Every other part of the council spent more than planned — Chief Executive, Resources, Communities and Housing, Climate and Environment and Major Projects — £2.282m more in total.
payload.evidence: The council set a budget for 2025/26 and its own accounts say it came in 1.03% under — £0.710m less than planned. Both numbers are in the narrative report at the front of that year's Statement of Accounts.
